offers_products.reason: Sells cinema advertising airtime and data insights; no physical goods or software licences as main offering.

offers_services.reason: Sells advertising placements in the Noovie preshow, lobby activations and digital campaigns, with measurement for advertisers.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Buyers are advertisers and brands; moviegoers are the audience, not the purchasers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Brands, advertisers and agencies buy cinema ad inventory across national, regional and local campaigns.

recurring_revenue.reason: Revenue comes from campaign-based advertising buys, which are mostly discrete rather than subscription or contract-based.

cyclical_demand.reason: Advertising budgets are easily cut or postponed in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Ad campaign buys are frequent, moderate-sized media purchases rather than large one-time investments.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for screen inventory, audience reach and data platform via theater partners, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main advertisers are national brands and agencies, though regional and local advertisers also buy.

asset_heavy.reason: Sells ad time on partner theaters' screens; it doesn't own theaters, so it needs little physical investment.

notes: Recurring revenue and large-customer answers are judgments based on typical advertiser behavior.
